findings.message: Row 1, column URL handle: the URL handle column is missing. This matters when you overwrite or update. A new product with no variants can omit it, because the handle is created from Title. An update requires URL handle and Title.
Row 4, column Status: Status is blank. When the Status column is present it needs a value on the product row (active, draft, or archived). Later variant rows in the sample file leave it blank.

Row 4, column Variant Image: "g" is not an absolute http:// or https:// URL. The importer requires http:// in front of an image URL, and product images are documented as publicly reachable https:// URLs.

Row 4, column Variant Weight Unit: "active" is not one of: g, kg, lb, or oz. Values are matched without case sensitivity because the sample CSV uses TRUE, FALSE, DENY, CONTINUE, and Active, while the column table shows those words in lowercase. Surrounding spaces are ignored.
